{{Top|leg}}
'''Parova's apartment''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[44 ABY]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sallinor Parova]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and acting [[Chief of Naval Operations|chief]] of its [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|navy]] had a recording of her favorite aria from the [[Music/Legends|opera]] ''[[The Eye of the Empire]]'' playing in her bedroom while preparing to [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]], but she was interrupted by a call; Parova was told by [[Rynog Asokaji]], the [[Aide/Legends|aide-de-camp]] of the naval chief, Admiral [[Nek Bwua'tu]], that the latter had recovered from his [[Coma/Legends|coma]] in the [[Galactic Senate Medcenter/Legends|Galactic Senate Medcenter]]. Asokaji arranged for a [[Taxi speeder|hovertaxi]] to pick Parova up outside her apartment to meet Bwua'tu, though the admiral was abducted in her taxi by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] before he [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the vehicle away.
